fields.acceptance: A Go test with a counting log reader: a default-view read with a landed, an accepted and a draft current change set picks as-is, to-be and what-if as today and folds no change sets; with a pending write it still sees the pending state; TestReadBudget times a default-view read with a landed current change set under the 50 ms budget
fields.statement: A read without --view takes the effective change set's state from the index, so with a current change set it costs no fold of the log and picks the same view as before
